svg.desc: 959 commits across five public projects, 70 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-22 through 2026-11-13 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-13T02:58:37.906Z.
